name: Geolocation
description: Access the user's location information such as latitude and longitude.

conditions.description: True if the current platform supports geolocation.
True if the user's location is currently being tracked.
Triggered when requesting or watching the user's position when the location is updated.
Triggered when a geolocation error occurs.

actions.display-text: Request location ({0} accuracy, timeout {1}, maximum age {2})
actions.description: Make a one-off request to get the user's current location.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.desc: The position accuracy to request. 'High' may take longer to get results and consume more battery.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.desc: The maximum length of time in seconds that the device can take to return a position.

maximum-age.name: Maximum age
maximum-age.desc: The maximum age in seconds of a cached result that can be returned. Use 0 to disable caching.

actions.display-text: Watch location ({0} accuracy, timeout {1}, maximum age {2})
actions.description: Start receiving regular updates of the user's location.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.desc: The position accuracy to request. 'High' may take longer to get results and consume more battery.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.desc: The maximum length of time in seconds that the device can take to return a position.

maximum-age.name: Maximum age
maximum-age.desc: The maximum age in seconds of a cached result that can be returned. Use 0 to disable caching.

actions.description: Stop watching a previous 'Watch location' action.

expressions.description: In 'On error', the relevant error message.
The timestamp at which the current details were retrieved.
The latitude position in decimal degrees.
The longitude position in decimal degrees.
The altitude above sea-level in meters, if available.
The estimated accuracy in meters of the latitude and longitude.
The estimated accuracy in meters of the altitude, if available.
The direction of travel in degrees relative to due north, if available.
The speed of travel in meters per second, if available.
